title: Synthesis and Cytotoxic Activity of 1,2,4-Triazolo-Linked Bis-Indolyl Conjugates as Dual Inhibitors of Tankyrase and PI3K.
authors: Yakkala, Prasanna A; Panda, Samir R; Shafi, Syed; Naidu, V G M; Yar, M Shahar; Ubanako, Philemon N; Adeyemi, Samson A; Kumar, Pradeep; Choonara, Yahya E; Radchenko, Eugene V; Palyulin, Vladimir A; Kamal, Ahmed
one_liner_zh: 该文研究三唑桥联双吲哚偶联物作为端锚聚合酶和PI3K双重抑制剂的合成与细胞毒性，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: A series of new 1,2,4-triazolo-linked bis-indolyl conjugates (15a-r) were prepared by multistep synthesis and evaluated for their cytotoxic activity against various human cancer cell lines. It was observed that they were more susceptible to colon and breast cancer cells. Conjugates 15o (IC(50) = 2.04 muM) and 15r (IC(50) = 0.85 muM) illustrated promising cytotoxicity compared to 5-fluorouracil (5-FU, IC(50) = 5.31 muM) against the HT-29 cell line. Interestingly, 15o and 15r induced cell cycle arrest at the G(0)/G(1) phase and disrupted the mitochondrial membrane potential. Moreover, these conjugates led to apoptosis in HT-29 at 2 muM and 1 muM, respectively, and also enhanced the total ROS production as well as the mitochondrial-generated ROS. Immunofluorescence and Western blot assays revealed that these conjugates reduced the expression levels of the PI3K-P85, beta-catenin, TAB-182, beta-actin, AXIN-2, and NF-kappaB markers that are involved in the beta-catenin pathway of colorectal cancer. The results of the in silico docking studies of 15r and 15o further support their dual inhibitory behaviour against PI3K and tankyrase. Interestingly, the conjugates have adequate ADME-toxicity parameters based on the calculated results of the molecular dynamic simulations, as we found that these inhibitors (15r) influenced the conformational flexibility of the 4OA7 and 3L54 proteins.
abstract_zh: 通过多步合成制备了一系列新型1,2,4-三唑连接的双吲哚基偶联物（15a-r），并评估了它们对多种人癌细胞系的细胞毒活性。观察到它们对结肠癌和乳腺癌细胞更为敏感。偶联物15o（IC(50) = 2.04 muM）和15r（IC(50) = 0.85 muM）与5-氟尿嘧啶（5-FU，IC(50) = 5.31 muM）相比，在HT-29细胞系中显示出有前景的细胞毒性。有趣的是，15o和15r诱导细胞周期阻滞在G(0)/G(1)期，并破坏线粒体膜电位。此外，这些偶联物分别在2 muM和1 muM浓度下导致HT-29细胞凋亡，并增强了总ROS产生以及线粒体生成的ROS。免疫荧光和Western blot实验显示，这些偶联物降低了参与结直肠癌β-catenin通路的PI3K-P85、β-catenin、TAB-182、β-actin、AXIN-2和NF-kappaB标志物的表达水平。15r和15o的计算机模拟对接研究结果进一步支持它们对PI3K和端锚聚合酶的双重抑制行为。有趣的是，基于分子动力学模拟的计算结果，这些偶联物具有足够的ADME-毒性参数，因为我们发现这些抑制剂（15r）影响了4OA7和3L54蛋白的构象灵活性。
